documents.purpose: Hubble OPAL Minnaert coefficient of Jupiter's visible map, red channel (F631N): the correction the map's producers divided out, which the lighting overlay puts back.

references.evidence: Simon, Wong and Orton (2015), Table 1, give k = 0.999 for F631N, the Minnaert correction removed before cylindrical projection; the Cycle 32 2025 README repeats it. The fitted phase range is Jupiter's phase on 27 June 2019, the colour map's epoch (3.3-3.5 degrees, JPL Horizons). The fitted emission range ends at 87.6 degrees: the outermost pixel of the WFC3/UVIS disc at the map's epoch (angular diameter from JPL Horizons, 0.0395 arcsec UVIS pixels), beyond which the observation resolved nothing.
